trap-nonspeakable.notes: THIS IS THE BEST-SCOPED BLOCK IN THE BATCH and the checks bear it out. VERIFIED: lambda_+ lambda_- = q(-1/q) = -1 exactly, consistent with det S = -1 and tr S = q - q^{-1}, and with S^2 = (q - q^{-1})S + 1. The 0-indexing is self-consistent: ordering[k] = proton for k odd and k < 2Z gives 'n p n n n' at A = 5, Z = 1, matching the stated counterexample, and 'proton position A - 5 leaves exactly four neutrons after it' is right in that same 0-indexed convention. SCOPE DISCIPLINE: the Scope section classifies the A >= 4 result as a structural exclusion and licenses it correctly — an explicit arrangement with strictly smaller Phi_q, proved on an interval — while labelling the minimising family 'empirical, covering A <= 16 only'. That is exactly the (a)/(b) discipline AGENTS.md asks for. ONE UNDER-CLAIM worth noting: if the gap really factors as (t - 1) times a degree-20 polynomial with all coefficients positive, then it is positive for every t > 1, i.e. for every q > 1 — stronger than 'an interval containing the substrate anchor'.
